name: object-storage-s3
description: Bun-native S3-compatible object storage for AWS S3 or MinIO-compatible services with a StorageService and presigned URLs.
instructions: Start Silo for local dev:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/minio.compose.yml up -d
The /storage demo routes need the auth module and an administrator session, and only reach keys under demo/.
Sign in as an administrator:  curl -c cookies.txt -XPOST localhost:5002/api/auth/sign-in/email -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"<password>"}'
Store an object:  curl -b cookies.txt -XPUT localhost:5002/storage/hello -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"content":"hi"}'
Read it back:     curl -b cookies.txt localhost:5002/storage/hello
For AWS S3: set STORAGE_PROVIDER=aws, remove S3_ENDPOINT, set S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=false and real credentials/bucket.
